text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
He-Hehehe. The letter I sent to Trainer... 
I got a long reply back... saying they 
were 'happy.'

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really. When I brought Trainer 
Kashimoto some refreshments, she seemed 
pretty happy about it, though.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that big bag of veggie chips? You 
devoured them in a flash!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It wasn't just about good 
intentions; I did my research properly 
before choosing it.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...*Hmph*. Trainer Kiryuin cannot be 
bribed with treats."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Trainer Kashimoto was definitely 
happy because I'm the one who picked it 
out!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Both the sentiment and giving it 
tangible form are necessary, aren't they? 
The important thing is bringing joy to 
your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
“—Yeah. I want to make Trainer Kiryuin 
even happier.”

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll tell you on one condition. What 
did you write in the letter?"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haha, guess it's a temporary truce for 
now!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Three heads are better than one! Let's 
make sure our Trainer has the biggest 
smile!
